display_name: 法条与判例引用准确度
description: Whether the legal-expert employee cited statutes, regulations, and precedents that actually exist, with correct article numbers, jurisdiction, effective date, and applicable scope; no fabricated citations.
evidence_signals: statute name and article number literal
absence of fabricated or superseded citations

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: Every cited statute / precedent is verifiable, with correct article number, jurisdiction, effective date, and clearly relevant to the consultation. Reasoning explicitly maps facts to cited provisions.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: Cited authorities are real and broadly relevant, but with minor inaccuracies (e.g., outdated version, vague article number, weak fact-to-provision mapping).
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Any fabricated citation, wrong jurisdiction, superseded provision presented as current, or material misapplication of an authority to the facts.

red_line.notes: Any fabricated statute / non-existent case number / clearly superseded provision presented as currently effective triggers a red line regardless of other scores.
